notes.title: Update log 2023.08.25
notes.content:
The content of this update is as follows:
1. Add viewing painting scaling and dragging function；
2. Modify the wrong words feedback from the curator；
3. Repair the painting appreciation, the suspension prompt after the mouse leaves, the problem of not disappearing；
4. Fix the painting description of the problem of using the mouse wheel to roll directly to the end；
5. Fix the problem that the first gold trophy is not accurate；
6. Fix some problems with some computer games without sound.

Some museums have no music after starting the game.
Please press the following steps to operate:
(1) Find [Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）]-[Right-click]-[Management]-[Browse local files];
(2) Return to the previous level, delete all the files in the game root directory, and return the Steam library to uninstall the game;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42619149/121dca94c83ec242c0f0fb24d0d6c6c96f0d567d.jpg[/img]
(3) Download the game and run.

Sorry to bring inconvenience to the curators, I wish you all a happy game!

tags.feature: 1. Add viewing painting scaling and dragging function；

tags.bug: 3. Repair the painting appreciation, the suspension prompt after the mouse leaves, the problem of not disappearing；
4. Fix the painting description of the problem of using the mouse wheel to roll directly to the end；
5. Fix the problem that the first gold trophy is not accurate；
6. Fix some problems with some computer games without sound.
